title: Jake Ferguson, Tyler Goodson will miss multiple weeks for Cowboys

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jake Ferguson, Tyler Goodson will miss multiple weeks for Cowboys
sources.description: The Cowboys will play "multiple weeks" without starting tight end Jake Ferguson and backup running back Tyler Goodson, coach Brian Schottenheimer said Monday.
